title: Machines
noBackend: This version of LordOS can't run machines.
emptyHint: A machine runs another system in a window, in its own sandbox. Start from a disk image or an ISO.
deleteDetail: The machine and its disks go to the Trash. You can restore them from there until you empty it.
deleteFailed: “{name}” couldn't be moved to the Trash.
ejectFailed: The ISO couldn't be taken out of “{name}”: is it still running?
bad.newer: Made by a newer version of LordOS
why.qemu-failed: The machine's engine stopped with an error.
why.guest-panic: The system inside it stopped with an error.
why.supervisor-lost: Its supervisor ended unexpectedly; it will be cleaned up at the next start.
why.forced: It didn't shut down in time and was turned off.
fix.qemu-signal: Start it again; if it keeps happening, the log below says where.
fix.out-of-memory: Give it less memory, or close other machines, and start it again.
fix.start-failed: The log below says what is missing.
fix.guest-panic: Start it again; if it keeps happening, the system inside needs repair.
fix.forced: Unsaved work in the machine may be lost.
win.gone: This machine isn't in the Machines folder any more.
win.noMemory: Not enough memory beside the machines already running: this one needs {need} MB with QEMU's own share, and {free} MB are left for machines. Shut one down, or give this one less memory.
win.cantAttach: The machine is running, but this window couldn't connect to it.
win.startingHint: The picture appears as soon as the machine shows one.
win.shuttingDownHint: The system inside is asked to shut down. If it doesn't answer, it is turned off after a minute.
win.noDisplayHint: This machine runs without a display.
req.title: Machines needs a few system parts
req.kvm: This computer has it, but your account can't use it yet. Without it, machines are much slower.
req.noKvm: This computer offers no hardware virtualization: machines are emulated, much slower.
req.notAdmin: An administrator of this computer has to do this.
new.title: New Machine
new.name: Name
new.memoryMax: Up to {max} MB on this computer
new.importHint: The image is copied into the machine; the original stays as it is.
new.isoHint: The ISO is attached read-only and the machine starts from it.
new.rootPassword: Root password for the first start (optional)
new.rootPasswordHint: Some images ask for it the first time they start (Debian's cloud images do). Only its hash is kept, until the machine's first clean shutdown.
new.err.nameBad: Use a shorter name, without control characters.
new.err.nameTaken: There is already a machine with that name.
new.warn.vcpus: More than {n} leaves this computer little to work with while the machine runs.
new.warn.emulated: Another architecture is emulated: expect it to be many times slower.
new.warn.noKvm: Without hardware virtualization this machine is emulated, much slower.
first.hint: Run another system in a window of this desktop, at full speed.
first.stepText: Machines needs permission to use this computer's virtualization. It asks once for an administrator.
first.offText: This computer doesn't offer hardware virtualization. If it has it, restart, open the firmware setup and turn it on (often under CPU or Advanced).
first.emulated: You can still run a machine now, emulated. It will be much slower.
req.use.kvm: KVM, so machines run at full speed
req.use.display: The picture of a machine in its window
req.use.network: passt: the machine's own network, no root
req.fromStore: Installed from Debian's packages through LordOS.
pi.title: {board}, {ram}
pi.native: Native machines are arm64, with up to {cpus} cores and {mem}.
pi.note.amd64: Small systems only, many times slower
pi.note.nested: This processor can't do nested virtualization
pi.emuText: {name} is amd64, so this computer imitates that processor. It runs many times slower than a native machine: fine for a small server, not for a full desktop.
pi.sdTitle: Machines are on a microSD card
pi.sdText: Machines will be slow here. An NVMe or USB 3 SSD works much better.
as.step.name: Name
as.title.choose: What do you want to run?
as.title.name: Name it
as.emulated: This is {arch}, and this computer is {host}: the machine will be emulated, much slower.
as.emulatedShort: Emulated: much slower than a machine of this computer's architecture.
as.profileHint.light: A server or a small system
as.profileHint.development: Builds, tools, several apps at once
as.profileNote: Kept within this computer: one core and the desktop's memory stay free (up to {mem} for a machine). Change it later in Configure.
as.r.diskCopy: A copy of the image, at least {n} GB
as.thenStart: It starts in its own window when it's ready.
cfg.title: {name}: Configure
cfg.laterSuspend: Suspending a machine to disk on close comes in a later version.
cfg.later3d: 3D graphics come in a later version.
cfg.laterPorts: Forwarded ports come in a later version.
cfg.laterSound: Sound in machines comes in a later version.
cfg.laterSharing: Shared folders and a shared clipboard come in a later version.
cfg.laterTpm: A virtual TPM and changing the boot order come in a later version.
cfg.needsOff: Changing this needs the machine off.
cfg.runningBanner: The machine is running: settings that need it off are dimmed.
cfg.onCloseNote: The system inside is asked to shut down; if it doesn't answer in a minute, it is turned off.
cfg.cpuNote: With QEMU's own share the machine may use up to {limit}. At most {max} for one machine: one core and the desktop's memory stay for this computer.
cfg.resolutionNote: The window's toolbar can pick a fixed resolution instead.
cfg.netNote.shared: The machine reaches the internet and the network through this computer, with its own address; nothing on this computer listens for it.
cfg.netNote.isolated: The machine has no network at all.
cfg.keyboardValue: This computer's, while the window is in front
cfg.pointerNote: Over the picture the pointer is the guest's own when the system shows one.
cfg.diskNote: Uses {used} on this computer now. A disk can grow, never shrink; the system inside may need its partition grown too.
cfg.cdRunning: Changing the disc needs the machine off in this version.
cfg.bootNote: An empty disk can't start, so a new machine starts from its ISO until a system is installed.
cfg.secNote.sandbox: QEMU runs with Landlock, two seccomp filters, no new privileges and no capabilities.
cfg.secNote.files: It may write only its disks, and read its firmware and ISO.
cfg.secNote.network: No sockets of its own: its network goes through passt, which listens on nothing.
cfg.secNote.limits: Its own cgroup: at most {limit} of memory and its vCPUs' worth of CPU.
cfg.secNote.display: A separate sandboxed helper copies the picture; lord-server never sees QEMU's memory.
cfg.secNote.secrets: A root password given at creation is kept only as a hash, until the first clean shutdown.
fs.hint: The bar hides by itself. Move to the top edge to see it.
fail.diskSafe: The system never ran; its disk is safe.
logs.title: {name} logs
